description: This file contains utility functions for managing DaemonSet pods in Kubernetes, including toleration management, template creation, surge calculations, pod update checks, and node affinity handling.

methods.name: GetTemplateGeneration
methods.description: Extracts the template generation number from a DaemonSet's deprecated annotation, returning a pointer to int64 and an error if parsing fails.

methods.name: AddOrUpdateDaemonPodTolerations
methods.description: Adds necessary tolerations to a PodSpec to ensure DaemonSet pods survive node taints and conditions.

methods.name: CreatePodTemplate
methods.description: Creates a copy of a PodTemplateSpec with added labels for generation and hash, and applies default tolerations.

methods.name: AllowsSurge
methods.description: Returns true if the DaemonSet allows more than one pod per node based on surge settings.

methods.name: SurgeCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of additional pods allowed (surge) during rolling updates, based on the DaemonSet's update strategy.

methods.name: UnavailableCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of pods that can be unavailable during rolling updates, based on the DaemonSet's update strategy.

methods.name: IsPodUpdated
methods.description: Checks if a pod's labels indicate it has been updated according to the DaemonSet's template generation or hash.

methods.name: ReplaceDaemonSetPodNodeNameNodeAffinity
methods.description: Replaces or sets the NodeAffinity of a pod's affinity to target a specific node name.

methods.name: GetTargetNodeName
methods.description: Retrieves the target node name for a DaemonSet pod, either from spec.NodeName or from node affinity rules.
